usage.unit-frames: Player / generic unit chrome — portrait well + attach HP/MP fillers
usage.boss-frames: Boss / elite target frames (large gold or dark skull)
usage.health-bars: Health track chrome + vertical blood vials
usage.fillers: Stretch or 9-slice interiors (red/green/blue/gold) driven by 0–1 percent
usage.overhead: World billboards above units; raycast-click → select unit
usage.structure: Bench / claim flag / ship / buildable entity HP frames & bars
usage.icons-gems: Pips, stars, diamonds for stacks / rarity / charges

overheadSelectable.interaction: Billboard above unit; pointer raycast → select entity id

structureEntityHp.use: benches, claim flags, ships, buildables — same fill% pattern as unit HP

gameWiring.barAssembly: Background = *_frame / unit_frame; fill layer width = pct * trackWidth (or 9-slice)

.oh-hp { pointer-events:auto; cursor:pointer; min-width:48px; height:8px;
  background:url(overhead_health) center/100% 100%; }
